evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically to the members identified in Brightline’s records. Fees would be separately subject to court approval
Brightline can discuss an automatic $27 million class fund plus $2 million in court-reviewed fees
with any unawarded amount added to the class fund
we can reduce the fee request to your proposed $2 million and propose a $33 million class fund

summary: Plaintiffs first raised attorneys’ fees, and fee amounts were included in offers before the class fund was settled. The transcript also expressly links fee reductions or unawarded fees to class recovery, though in a class-protective way. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized firm economics, that defense leveraged fee interests, that a reverse auction occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
